roleTitle: MMA Senior Client Manager Rx Solutions

job.rawJd:
Marsh McLennan Agency is hiring a Senior Client Manager for its Rx Solutions team. MMA provides business insurance, employee health and benefits, retirement, and private client insurance solutions. Rx Solutions uses clinical analytics, pharmacy contract language, formulary strategy, employee purchasing trends, and ongoing program management to identify savings and improve pharmacy benefits.

The Senior Client Manager manages client deliverables, supports Regional Directors, and works with the Rx Solutions team, MMA field teams, pharmacy benefit managers, and strategic partners to meet deadlines. The role is the primary resource for pharmacy questions, reviews draft contracts against MMA provisions and best practices, helps analyze and negotiate employer pharmacy-benefit contracts, tracks deliverables, coordinates reporting and presentations, communicates with clients and company representatives, and follows industry changes for compliance and risk reduction. The work supports sales growth, client retention, savings opportunities, clinical and formulary recommendations, and member engagement.

Required qualifications include a bachelor's degree or equivalent career experience; knowledge of pharmacy terminology, pharmacy cost drivers, and PBM contracts; aptitude for data analytics; at least ten years of Account Management, Pharmacy Benefit Management, and/or Carrier experience; and permanent ongoing US work authorization without sponsorship. Pharmacy pricing or underwriting is preferred. Current Life and Health licensure, or the ability to obtain it within 90 days, is also preferred.

classification.primarySource: The resume proves eight years of direct pharmaceutical account leadership, Fortune 500 client relationships, budgets up to $20M, client and financial reporting, regulated review, cross-functional delivery, and analytics-backed recommendations. It does not prove PBM work, pharmacy-benefit contract expertise, pharmacy pricing, or ten years in account management, PBM, or carrier roles.
classification.supportingSource: The portfolio validates regulated healthcare workflows, enterprise analytics, research, data visualization, and presentation-ready recommendations. It strengthens the client-management and analytics case but cannot replace direct PBM, formulary, pharmacy-cost, or contract-negotiation experience.
